Container.Name: hass-mcp
Container.Overview: Home Assistant MCP server, bridged over HTTP with supergateway (baked into the image, on a current Node.js so supergateway's MCP SDK actually works) so any MCP client that speaks HTTP/SSE can use it.
Container.Requires: A Home Assistant long-lived access token (Profile -> Security -> Long-lived access tokens).

Config.Name: Host Port 8094
Config.Description: HTTP port supergateway serves the bridged MCP endpoint on.

Config.Name: hass-token
Config.Description: Read-only bind mount to a file containing your Home Assistant long-lived access token (never put the token directly in a Variable).
